descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
All’interno del dipartimento di Ingegneria CERN (EN), il gruppo di Ingegneria Elettrica (EL) è responsabile della gestione della rete di distribuzione elettrica del CERN, che va da 400 kV a 400/230 V, che comprende il suo funzionamento, manutenzione, ristrutturazione, controllo e la previsione del consumo energetico e la gestione delle relazioni con i fornitori. Inoltre, il gruppo supervisiona l'infrastruttura di cablaggio, gestendo tutto dall'installazione e rimozione dei cavi, raffreddati ad acqua e fibra ottica al mantenimento delle loro strutture di supporto.

Vi unirete alla sezione Manutenzione e Operazione (EN-EL-MO), responsabile del funzionamento e della manutenzione della rete elettrica del CERN, della messa in servizio di nuove installazioni e dell’esecuzione di piccoli impianti elettrici.
In qualità di esperto tecnico elettrico industriale nella sezione EN-EL-MO, sarete responsabili di operare e mantenere parte della rete elettrica ad alta e bassa tensione del CERN.
Applica la tua esperienza per supportare il funzionamento, la manutenzione, il consolidamento e lo sviluppo dei sistemi di trasmissione e distribuzione elettrica del CERN, la spina dorsale di uno dei più grandi e potenti collider di particelle al mondo. Unisciti al team di ingegneria elettrica del CERN. Prendi parte!
Funzioni
Come responsabile del mantenimento e del funzionamento di una parte della rete elettrica del CERN, Lei:

• Operare la rete ad alta e bassa tensione (blocchi, accensione e spegnimento di apparecchiature elettriche, riconfigurazione di rete).

• Eseguire la risoluzione dei problemi e le riparazioni, gli interventi dei documenti, e portare o contribuire alla preparazione dei rapporti tecnici.

• Eseguire ispezioni regolari per garantire l'affidabilità e la sicurezza della rete elettrica.

• Agire come persona di contatto per gli utenti collegati alla rete elettrica all'interno dell'area assegnata.

• Superare attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, nonché lavori elettrici.

• Contribuire a progetti elettrici eseguiti dal Gruppo: partecipare a riunioni di progetto, assistere alla definizione di soluzioni tecniche, preparare ed eseguire test e attività di messa in servizio, e eseguire test di accettazione su impianti ad alta e bassa tensione.

• Mantenere registri accurati di attività di manutenzione e di funzionamento, tra cui il lavoro svolto, i problemi incontrati e le azioni correttive intraprese.

Certificato tecnico o istruzione secondaria generale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica o di un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

• Buona conoscenza dei sistemi di distribuzione elettrica ad alta e bassa tensione e delle attrezzature associate.

• Esperienza comprovata nel funzionamento e nella manutenzione di impianti elettrici, tra cui la risoluzione dei problemi, la diagnosi dei guasti, le riparazioni e le attività di messa in servizio.

• Dimostrata capacità di lavorare autonomamente mentre coordina le attività con utenti, appaltatori e specialisti tecnici in un ambiente multidisciplinare.

• Esperienza utilizzando un sistema di gestione della manutenzione informatizzata (CMMS) per la registrazione delle attività di manutenzione e di funzionamento.

• Esperienza nella lettura, l'aggiornamento e la gestione di disegni elettrici, documentazione tecnica e record as-built.
Competenze tecniche:

• Funzionamento e manutenzione di circuiti elettrici e reti.

• Costruzione, test e messa in servizio di circuiti elettrici e reti.

• Conoscenza del sistema di gestione della manutenzione computerizzata (CMMS).
Competenze comportamentali:

• Risultati: lavoro di guida / progetti lungo e vederli attraverso alla loro conclusione.

• Dimostrare la responsabilità: assumersi la responsabilità delle proprie azioni e decisioni.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: dimostrare la volontà di accettare circostanze mutevoli; sostenere iniziative di cambiamento.

• Lavorare in team: costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro costruttive ed efficaci.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 06.09.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco
Questa posizione comporta:

• Partecipazione ad un regolare servizio di stand-by, comprese le notti, la domenica e le festività ufficiali.

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

• Una patente di guida valida.

• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.

• Esposizione a campi elettromagnetici in determinate condizioni di esposizione.

• In considerazione dei rischi per la salute sul lavoro associati a questa posizione, il candidato selezionato deve ottenere l'autorizzazione medica prima che venga confermata un'offerta contrattuale.
Grado di lavoro: 3-4
Riferimento del lavoro: EN-EL-MO-2026-164-LD
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria elettrica o elettronica
Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: tecnico elettrico

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung
Innerhalb der Abteilung CERN Engineering (EN) ist die Gruppe Elektrotechnik (EL) für die Verwaltung des elektrischen Verteilungsnetzes des CERN von 400 kV bis 400/230 V verantwortlich, das den Betrieb, die Wartung, die Renovierung, die Steuerung sowie die Vorhersage des Energieverbrauchs und die Abwicklung der Beziehungen zu Lieferanten umfasst. Darüber hinaus überwacht die Gruppe die Kabelinfrastruktur und verwaltet alles von der Installation und Entfernung von Steuerungs-, Wasser- und Glasfaserkabeln bis hin zur Wartung ihrer tragenden Strukturen.

Sie werden der Abteilung Wartung und Betrieb (EN-EL-MO) beitreten, die für den Betrieb und die Wartung des elektrischen Netzes des CERN, die Inbetriebnahme neuer Installationen und die Durchführung kleiner elektrischer Arbeiten verantwortlich ist.
Als erfahrener Elektrotechniker im Bereich EN-EL-MO sind Sie für den Betrieb und die Wartung eines Teils des Hoch- und Niederspannungsnetzes des CERN verantwortlich.
Wenden Sie Ihr Fachwissen an, um den Betrieb, die Wartung, die Konsolidierung und die Entwicklung der elektrischen Übertragungs- und Verteilungssysteme des CERN, dem Rückgrat eines der weltweit größten und leistungsstärksten Teilchenbeschleuniger, zu unterstützen. Treten Sie dem Elektrotechnik-Team des CERN bei. Nimm teil!
Funktionen
Als Verantwortliche für die Wartung und den Betrieb eines Teils des elektrischen Netzes des CERN werden Sie:

• Betrieb des Hoch- und Niederspannungsnetzes (Lockouts, Ein- und Ausschalten von elektrischen Geräten, Netzrekonfiguration).

• Führen Sie Fehlersuche und Reparaturen durch, dokumentieren Sie Interventionen und führen Sie oder tragen Sie zur Erstellung von technischen Berichten bei.

• Führen Sie regelmäßige Inspektionen durch, um die Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit des elektrischen Netzes zu gewährleisten.

• Handeln Sie als Ansprechpartner für Benutzer, die an das elektrische Netzwerk innerhalb des zugewiesenen Bereichs angeschlossen sind.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie vorbeugende und korrigierende Wartungsarbeiten sowie elektrische Arbeiten.

• Beitrag zu von der Gruppe durchgeführten Elektroprojekten: Teilnahme an Projektbesprechungen, Unterstützung bei der Definition technischer Lösungen, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Tests und Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten sowie Durchführung von Abnahmetests bei Hoch- und Niederspannungsinstallationen.

• Führen Sie genaue Aufzeichnungen über Instandhaltungs- und Betriebstätigkeiten, einschließlich durchgeführter Arbeiten, aufgetretener Probleme und ergriffener Korrekturmaßnahmen.

Technisches Zertifikat oder allgemeine Sekundarschulbildung oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Gebiet.

Erfahrung:

• Gute Kenntnisse der elektrischen Hoch- und Niederspannungsverteilungssysteme und der zugehörigen Geräte.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Wartung von Elektroinstallationen, einschließlich Fehlerbehebung, Fehlerdiagnose, Reparaturen und Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig Aktivitäten mit Benutzern, Auftragnehmern und technischen Spezialisten in einem multidisziplinären Umfeld zu koordinieren.

• Erfahrung mit einem Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) zur Aufzeichnung von Wartungs- und Betriebsaktivitäten.

• Erfahrung im Lesen, Aktualisieren und Verwalten elektrischer Zeichnungen, technischer Dokumentation und eingebauter Aufzeichnungen.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Betrieb und Wartung von Stromkreisen und Netzen.

• Bau, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme von Stromkreisen und Netzen.

• Kenntnisse im Bereich Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Ergebnisse erzielen: Arbeiten / Projekte vorantreiben und bis zum Abschluss begleiten.

• Nachweis der Rechenschaftspflicht: Übernahme von Verantwortung für eigene Handlungen und Entscheidungen.

• Flexibilität demonstrieren: Bereitschaft zeigen, sich ändernde Umstände zu akzeptieren; Initiativen für Veränderungen unterstützen.

• Arbeiten in Teams: Aufbau und Pflege konstruktiver und effektiver Arbeitsbeziehungen.
Sprachkenntnisse:
Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation
Au sein du département d'ingénierie du CERN (EN), le groupe d'ingénierie électrique (EL) est chargé de la gestion du réseau de distribution électrique du CERN, qui va de 400 kV à 400/230 V, ce qui comprend son fonctionnement, son entretien, sa rénovation, son contrôle ainsi que la prévision de la consommation d'énergie et des relations de manutention avec les fournisseurs. De plus, le groupe supervise l'infrastructure de câblage, en gérant tout, depuis l'installation et l'enlèvement des câbles de commande, refroidis par eau et à fibres optiques jusqu'à l'entretien de leurs structures de support.

Vous rejoindrez la section Maintenance et fonctionnement (EN-EL-MO), responsable de l'exploitation et de l'entretien du réseau électrique du CERN, de la mise en service de nouvelles installations et de l'exécution de petits travaux électriques.
En tant que technicien industriel en électricité expérimenté dans la section EN-EL-MO, vous serez responsable du fonctionnement et de l'entretien d'une partie du réseau électrique haute et basse tension du CERN.
Appliquez votre expertise pour soutenir le fonctionnement, la maintenance, la consolidation et le développement des systèmes de transmission et de distribution électriques du CERN, l'épine dorsale de l'un des plus grands et des plus puissants collisions de particules au monde. Rejoignez l'équipe de génie électrique du CERN. Participez !
Fonctions
En tant que responsable de l'entretien et de l'exploitation d'une partie du réseau électrique du CERN, vous:

• Fonctionnement du réseau haute et basse tension (verrouillages, mise en marche et arrêt de l'équipement électrique, reconfiguration du réseau).

• Effectuer le dépannage et les réparations, documenter les interventions et diriger ou contribuer à la préparation des rapports techniques.

• Effectuer des inspections régulières pour assurer la fiabilité et la sécurité du réseau électrique.

• Agir comme personne de contact pour les utilisateurs connectés au réseau électrique dans la zone assignée.

• Superviser les activités de maintenance préventive et corrective, ainsi que les travaux électriques.

• Contribuer aux projets électriques exécutés par le Groupe : participer à des réunions de projet, aider à la définition de solutions techniques, préparer et exécuter des essais et des activités de mise en service, et effectuer des essais d'acceptation sur des installations à haute et basse tension.

• Tenir des registres exacts des activités de maintenance et d'exploitation, y compris les travaux effectués, les problèmes rencontrés et les mesures correctives prises.

Certificat technique ou enseignement secondaire général ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine du génie électrique ou un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Bonne connaissance des systèmes de distribution électrique à haute et basse tension et de l'équipement connexe.

• Expérience éprouvée dans le fonctionnement et l'entretien d'installations électriques, y compris le dépannage, le diagnostic de défaillance, les réparations et les activités de mise en service.

• Capacité démontrée de travailler de façon autonome tout en coordonnant les activités avec les utilisateurs, les entrepreneurs et les spécialistes techniques dans un environnement multidisciplinaire.

• Expérience de l'utilisation d'un système informatisé de gestion de la maintenance (CMMS) pour enregistrer la maintenance et les activités opérationnelles.

• Expérience de la lecture, de la mise à jour et de la gestion des dessins électriques, de la documentation technique et des documents tels que construits.
Compétences techniques:

• Fonctionnement et entretien des circuits et réseaux électriques.

• Construction, essais et mise en service de circuits et réseaux électriques.

• Connaissance du système informatisé de gestion de la maintenance (CMMS).
Compétences comportementales :

• Atteindre des résultats: conduire des travaux / projets le long et les voir jusqu'à leur conclusion.

• Démontrer la responsabilité : prendre la responsabilité de ses propres actions et décisions.

• Démontrer la souplesse : démontrer la volonté d'accepter des circonstances changeantes; appuyer les initiatives de changement.

• Travailler en équipe : établir et maintenir des relations de travail constructives et efficaces.
Compétences linguistiques :
Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.

Nous accueillons favorablement les candidatures de tous les États membres et États membres associés .
Ce poste sera pourvu dès que possible, et les candidatures devraient normalement nous parvenir au plus tard le 06.09.2026 à 23:59 CEST .

Type de contrat: Contrat à durée limitée (5 ans). Sous réserve de certaines conditions, les titulaires de contrats à durée limitée peuvent demander un emploi pour une durée indéterminée.
Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine
Flexibilité de l'emploi : entièrement sur place

• Compte tenu des risques pour la santé au travail associés à ce poste, le candidat sélectionné doit obtenir une attestation médicale avant de confirmer une offre de contrat.

Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. jobs.description:
The EP-ATL-PO section plays a key role in the upgrade and maintenance of the ATLAS detector at the LHC. As a Junior Mechanical Technician, you will support experienced colleagues in mechanical installation and integration activities on the detector and its infrastructure during Long Shutdown 3 (LS3), while gaining hands-on experience in a cutting-edge experimental physics environment.
 Your responsibilities:

• Participate in large-scale ATLAS detector movements in the experimental cavern and in the installation of access platforms.

• Support sub-detector installation activities, including handling, transport, and positioning using appropriate lifting and alignment techniques.

• Prepare and set up work areas and tooling, and provide logistical support for detector interventions.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, perform basic dimensional checks, and report progress to supervising engineers.

• When required, manufacture parts and tooling using conventional machining techniques, such as drilling, milling, and turning.
 Your profile:

• Initial hands-on experience in mechanical assembly, fitting, or maintenance.

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and 2D/3D CAD models.

• Initial experience with conventional machining techniques and workshop practices.

• Basic metrology skills, including the use of calipers, gauges, and dimensional inspection tools.

• Awareness of occupational health and safety principles in workshop and industrial environments.
 Skills:

• Follow technical procedures, assembly instructions, and work specifications.

• Use of standard hand and power tools for mechanical operations.

• Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in an international and multidisciplinary environment.

• Rigorous, detail-oriented, and safety-conscious approach to work.

• Accurately document completed work and maintain high quality standards while following technical procedures and safety requirements.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date:  14.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-November-2026
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.
 Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job reference: EP-ATL-PO-2026-178-GRAE
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark job: 300090 - Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.de:
The EP-ATL-PO section plays a key role in the upgrade and maintenance of the ATLAS detector at the LHC. As a Junior Mechanical Technician, you will support experienced colleagues in mechanical installation and integration activities on the detector and its infrastructure during Long Shutdown 3 (LS3), while gaining hands-on experience in a cutting-edge experimental physics environment.
Your responsibilities:

• Participate in large-scale ATLAS detector movements in the experimental cavern and in the installation of access platforms.

• Support sub-detector installation activities, including handling, transport, and positioning using appropriate lifting and alignment techniques.

• Prepare and set up work areas and tooling, and provide logistical support for detector interventions.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, perform basic dimensional checks, and report progress to supervising engineers.

• When required, manufacture parts and tooling using conventional machining techniques, such as drilling, milling, and turning.
Your profile:

• Initial hands-on experience in mechanical assembly, fitting, or maintenance.

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and 2D/3D CAD models.

• Initial experience with conventional machining techniques and workshop practices.

• Basic metrology skills, including the use of calipers, gauges, and dimensional inspection tools.

• Awareness of occupational health and safety principles in workshop and industrial environments.
Skills:

• Follow technical procedures, assembly instructions, and work specifications.

• Use of standard hand and power tools for mechanical operations.

• Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in an international and multidisciplinary environment.

• Rigorous, detail-oriented, and safety-conscious approach to work.

• Accurately document completed work and maintain high quality standards while following technical procedures and safety requirements.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 14.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-November-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job reference: EP-ATL-PO-2026-178-GRAE
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark job: 300090 - Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer (IPT-PI-SU-2026-184-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer ( IPT ) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Functions
 In the role of Procurement and Contracts Officer, you will:

• Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.

• Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.

• Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.

• Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN’s Management.

• Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.

• Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.

• Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.

• Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.

• Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.

• Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.

• Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
 Technical competencies:

• Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.

• Negotiating with external suppliers and service contract providers.

• Drafting of commercial documents for a supply or a service contract.

• Contract management: managing the commercial aspects of contracts, including the critical examination of offers and the handling of claims and disputes.

• Reviewing technical documents for a supply or a service contract.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Managing Self: taking initiative beyond regular tasks and making things happen.

• Communicating Effectively: utilising effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.

• Solving Problems: identifying, defining and assessing problems, taking action to address them.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: demonstrating a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supporting initiatives for change.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 21.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Number of open positions: 2
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Hybrid
 Job grade: 6-7
 Job reference: IPT-PI-SU-2026-184-LD
 Field of work: Procurement
 Benchmark Job Title: Procurement Professional

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
Nell'ambito del Dipartimento Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT ) vi unirete al Gruppo Procurement and Industrial Services (PI), che è responsabile per l'acquisizione di tutte le forniture e servizi per l'Organizzazione, assicurando che i requisiti tecnici, di consegna e di prestazione specificati e contrattuali siano rispettati al minimo costo complessivo possibile, raggiungendo i rendimenti industriali equilibrati per gli Stati membri del CERN e rispettando le regole di approvvigionamento del CERN. Il Gruppo monitora e segnala le attività di approvvigionamento e le statistiche dei rappresentanti del CERN Management e degli Stati membri.

Funzioni
Nel ruolo di Procurement and Contracts Officer, Lei:

• Consigliare e sostenere l'Organizzazione nell'individuazione delle strategie di approvvigionamento, garantendo efficienza e qualità dei costi.

• Eseguire la ricerca per identificare e partecipare alla qualificazione dei potenziali fornitori.

• Preparare richieste di prezzi, sondaggi di mercato e inviti a presentare offerte in conformità con le regole di approvvigionamento dell'Organizzazione e su base internazionale.

• Analizzare le offerte, preparare le proposte di giudizio e presentare queste alla Direzione del CERN.

• Assicurare la preparazione, la negoziazione e il follow-up di numerosi ordini e contratti.

• Contribuisci all'avanzamento delle tecniche e degli strumenti di approvvigionamento del CERN, influenzando la loro modernizzazione e ottimizzazione.

• Promuovere e sostenere una vasta rete di relazioni su diversi livelli, sia internamente che esternamente, rappresentando attivamente il CERN in eventi aziendali globali.

Laurea magistrale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'economia, dell'acquisto, della legge, dell'ingegneria o di un campo relativo.

Esperienza:

• Esperienza dimostrata nell'approvvigionamento di forniture tecniche o servizi con una forte comprensione dei processi sorgente-contrattuali e dei sistemi di approvvigionamento.

• Esperienza nell'impostazione delle strategie di categoria o di approvvigionamento a livello di progetto.

• Esperienza nell'esecuzione dei piani in un processo decisionale a matrice.

• Esperienza nella collaborazione con diversi team e stakeholder senior.

• L'esperienza negli appalti pubblici e la gestione dei contratti è desiderata.
Competenze tecniche:

• Definizione delle strategie di aggiudicazione e di aggiudicazione.

• Negoziare con fornitori esterni e fornitori di servizi.

• Redazione di documenti commerciali per una fornitura o un contratto di servizio.

• Gestione dei contratti: gestione degli aspetti commerciali dei contratti, compresa l'esame critico delle offerte e la gestione di reclami e controversie.

• Revisione dei documenti tecnici per una fornitura o un contratto di servizio.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Ottenere risultati: fornire lavoro di alta qualità nel tempo e soddisfare le aspettative.

• Gestire il Sé: prendere iniziativa oltre i compiti regolari e fare accadere le cose.

• Comunicare efficacemente: utilizzare tecniche di negoziazione efficaci per ottenere risultati a lungo termine accettabile per tutte le parti coinvolte.

• Risolvere i problemi: identificare, definire e valutare i problemi, agire per affrontarli.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: dimostrare la volontà di accettare circostanze mutevoli; sostenere iniziative di cambiamento.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 21.09.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Numero di posizioni aperte: 2
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido
Grado di lavoro: 6-7
Riferimento del lavoro: IPT-PI-SU-2026-184-LD
Campo di lavoro: Appalti
Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Procurement Professional

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!
Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung
Als Teil der Abteilung für Industrie, Beschaffung und Wissenstransfer (IPT) treten Sie der Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI) bei, die für die Beschaffung aller Lieferungen und Dienstleistungen für die Organisation verantwortlich ist, um sicherzustellen, dass die angegebenen und vertraglichen technischen, Liefer- und Leistungsanforderungen zu möglichst geringen Gesamtkosten erfüllt werden, während ausgewogene industrielle Erträge für die CERN-Mitgliedstaaten erzielt werden und die CERN-Beschaffungsregeln eingehalten werden. Die Gruppe überwacht und berichtet über Beschaffungsaktivitäten und Statistiken an das CERN Management und die Vertreter der Mitgliedstaaten.

Funktionen
In der Rolle des Procurement and Contracts Officer werden Sie:

• Beratung und Unterstützung der Organisation bei der Ermittlung von Beschaffungsstrategien, um Kosteneffizienz und Qualität zu gewährleisten.

• Durchführung von Untersuchungen zur Identifizierung und Teilnahme an der Qualifizierung potenzieller Lieferanten.

• Bereiten Sie Preisanfragen, Marktumfragen und Ausschreibungen gemäß den Beschaffungsregeln der Organisation und auf internationaler Basis vor.

• Analysieren Sie Angebote, erstellen Sie Vorschläge für Urteile und reichen Sie diese an das Management des CERN ein.

• Gewährleistung der Vorbereitung, Verhandlung und Weiterverfolgung zahlreicher Aufträge und Verträge.

• Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Beschaffungstechniken und -werkzeuge des CERN, um deren Modernisierung und Optimierung zu beeinflussen.

• Pflegen und pflegen Sie ein weitreichendes Netzwerk von Beziehungen auf verschiedenen Ebenen, sowohl intern als auch extern, und vertreten Sie das CERN aktiv bei globalen Geschäftsereignissen.

Master-Abschluss oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich Wirtschaft, Einkauf, Recht, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich.

Erfahrung:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Beschaffung von technischen Lieferungen oder Dienstleistungen mit einem starken Verständnis von Source-to-Contract-Prozessen und Beschaffungssystemen.

• Erfahrung in der Festlegung von Kategorien- oder Beschaffungsstrategien auf Projektebene.

• Erfahrung in der Ausführung von Plänen in einem matrixgesteuerten Entscheidungsprozess.

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams und leitenden Stakeholdern.

• Erfahrung im öffentlichen Auftragswesen und Vertragsmanagement ist erwünscht.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Festlegung von Ausschreibungs- und Vergabestrategien.

• Verhandlungen mit externen Lieferanten und Dienstleistungsanbietern.

• Erstellung von Geschäftsunterlagen für einen Liefer- oder Dienstleistungsvertrag.

• Vertragsmanagement: Verwaltung der kaufmännischen Aspekte von Verträgen, einschließlich der kritischen Prüfung von Angeboten und der Bearbeitung von Ansprüchen und Streitigkeiten.

• Prüfung technischer Unterlagen für einen Liefer- oder Dienstleistungsvertrag.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Ergebnisse erzielen: qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit pünktlich liefern und Erwartungen erfüllen.

• Selbstmanagement: Initiative ergreifen, die über normale Aufgaben hinausgeht und Dinge möglich macht.

• Effektive Kommunikation: Nutzung effektiver Verhandlungstechniken, um langfristige Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die für alle Beteiligten akzeptabel sind.

• Probleme lösen: Probleme identifizieren, definieren und bewerten, Maßnahmen ergreifen, um sie zu lösen.

• Flexibilität demonstrieren: Bereitschaft zeigen, sich ändernde Umstände zu akzeptieren; Initiativen für Veränderungen unterstützen.
Sprachkenntnisse:
Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen.

Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag:
Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt, und Anträge sollten uns normalerweise spätestens am 21.09.2026 um 23:59 Uhr erreichen.
Beschäftigungsbedingungen
Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (5 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen.
Anzahl der offenen Positionen: 2
Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Hybrid
Job Grade: 6-7
Berufsbezeichnung: IPT-PI-SU-2026-184-LD
Arbeitsgebiet: Beschaffung
Benchmark Job Title: Procurement Professional

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 8 Jahre + Anspruch auf unbefristete Vertragsdauer zu verlängern.
Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation
Dans le cadre du département Industrie, Approvisionnement et Transfert de Connaissances (IPT), vous rejoindrez le Groupe Achat et Services Industriels (PI), qui est chargé d'acheter toutes les fournitures et tous les services pour l'Organisation, en veillant à ce que les exigences techniques, de livraison et de performance spécifiées et contractuelles soient respectées au coût global le plus bas possible, tout en assurant un rendement industriel équilibré pour les États membres du CERN et en respectant les règles d'approvisionnement du CERN. Le Groupe surveille et rend compte des activités d'achat et des statistiques au CERN Management et aux représentants des États membres.

Fonctions
Dans le rôle d'agent des achats et des marchés, vous :

• Conseiller et aider l ' Organisation à définir des stratégies en matière d ' achats, en veillant à leur rentabilité et à leur qualité.

• Mener des recherches pour identifier les fournisseurs potentiels et y participer.

• Préparer les demandes de renseignements sur les prix, les études de marché et les appels d'offres conformément aux Règles de l'Organisation relatives aux achats et sur le plan international.

• Analyser les offres, préparer les propositions de sélection et les soumettre à la direction du CERN.

• Assurer la préparation, la négociation et le suivi de nombreux ordres et contrats.

• Contribuer à l'avancement des techniques et outils d'approvisionnement du CERN, en influençant leur modernisation et leur optimisation.

• Favoriser et maintenir un vaste réseau de relations à différents niveaux, tant à l'interne qu'à l'externe, tout en représentant activement le CERN dans les événements commerciaux mondiaux.

Maîtrise ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine de l'économie, des achats, du droit, de l'ingénierie ou d'un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Expérience démontrée en matière d'achat de fournitures ou de services techniques avec une bonne compréhension des processus source-contrat et des systèmes d'approvisionnement.

• Expérience dans l'établissement de stratégies de catégorie ou d'achat au niveau du projet.

• Expérience de l'exécution des plans dans le cadre d'un processus décisionnel axé sur la matrice.

• Expérience de la collaboration avec diverses équipes et intervenants supérieurs.

• Une expérience de la gestion des marchés publics et des marchés est souhaitée.
Compétences techniques:

• Définition des stratégies d'appel d'offres et de passation de marchés.

• Négociation avec les fournisseurs externes et les fournisseurs de services.

• Rédaction de documents commerciaux pour un contrat de fourniture ou de service.

• Gestion des contrats : gestion des aspects commerciaux des contrats, y compris l'examen critique des offres et le traitement des réclamations et des différends.

• Examen des documents techniques pour un contrat de fourniture ou de service.
Compétences comportementales :

• Atteindre des résultats : fournir un travail de haute qualité dans les délais et répondre aux attentes.

• Gérer soi: prendre des initiatives au-delà des tâches régulières et faire les choses arriver.

• Communiquer efficacement : utiliser des techniques de négociation efficaces pour obtenir des résultats à long terme acceptables pour toutes les parties concernées.

• Résoudre les problèmes : identifier, définir et évaluer les problèmes, prendre des mesures pour y remédier.

• Démontrer la souplesse : démontrer la volonté d'accepter des circonstances changeantes; appuyer les initiatives de changement.
Compétences linguistiques :
Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.

Admissibilité et date de clôture:
La diversité fait partie intégrante de la mission du CERN depuis sa fondation et constitue une valeur établie pour l'Organisation. Notre réussite repose sur l'emploi d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée. Nous accueillons favorablement les candidatures de tous les États membres et États membres associés .
Ce poste sera pourvu dès que possible, et les candidatures devraient normalement nous parvenir au plus tard le 21.09.2026 à 23:59 CEST .
Conditions d'emploi
Type de contrat: Contrat à durée limitée (5 ans). Sous réserve de certaines conditions, les titulaires de contrats à durée limitée peuvent demander un emploi pour une durée indéterminée.
Nombre de postes ouverts: 2
Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine
Flexibilité de l'emploi : hybride
Niveau d'emploi: 6-7
Référence de l'emploi: IPT-PI-SU-2026-184-LD
Domaine d ' activité : achats
Titre du poste-repère : Approvisionnement

Avantages globaux

• Un salaire compétitif (sans impôt), augmentant en fonction de vos années d'expérience pertinente.

• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.

• Un forfait de réinstallation (subvention d'installation, déménagement, frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.

• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 8 ans + éligibilité à un contrat de durée indéterminée.
Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible !
Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent.
Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu.
Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît !

jobs.title: Electro-Mechanical Technician (TE-MSC-HSD-2026-193-GRAE)
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy building, assembling and bringing machines to life?
 Join CERN and contribute to the development of advanced electro-mechanical equipment used in a unique high-technology environment. Working alongside experienced engineers and technicians, you will take part in the design, assembly, wiring, testing and commissioning of specialised machines, gaining hands-on experience across electrical, mechanical and control systems.
 We will provide all the training you need. What matters most is your curiosity, practical mindset, and eagerness to learn.
 Your responsibilities

• Learn how to inspect and test advanced materials, carrying out quality checks and measurements to ensure they meet specifications.

• Support laboratory testing activities and help evaluate how materials behave under different mechanical conditions.

• Gain hands-on experience in creating electrical diagrams, wiring equipment, programming PLCs, and commissioning electro-mechanical machines.

• Participate in the assembly, testing and operation of specialised machinery used in a cutting-edge engineering environment.

• Work with experienced engineers and technicians to integrate new materials into innovative cables and coils for future technologies.
 More information here .
 Your profile

• Basic experience in electrical testing or material testing.

• Basic experience in reading and drawing of circuit diagrams.

• Experience in the cabling and commissioning of electrical cabinets or machines is an advantage.

• Experience in mechanical assembly is an advantage.
 Skills

• Knowledge in instrumentation and data acquisition is an advantage.

• Able to work independently and in teams.

• Reliable and autonomous.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 13.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-October-2026
 This position involves:

• A valid driving licence.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
 Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job reference: TE-MSC-HSD-2026-193-GRAE
 Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
 Benchmark job: 300050 - Electromechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

jobs.description:
Looking for an opportunity to apply your mechanical engineering skills to the upgrade of the world's most powerful particle accelerator? Join CERN's Vacuum, Surfaces and Coatings (VSC) Group and contribute to the upgrade of critical beam vacuum systems that are essential for the performance and reliability of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC).
 Working alongside experienced engineers, technicians and physicists, you will support the installation, testing and commissioning of key equipment that will help prepare the LHC for future scientific discoveries. No prior experience in particle accelerators is required. We will provide all the necessary training and support, making this an excellent opportunity to develop specialist skills in a unique international environment.
 Your responsibilities

• Perform vacuum acceptance testing of baked components intended for installation in the HL-LHC collimator upgrade.

• Test and validate vacuum equipment before installation, perform residual gas analysis (RGA) ensuring it meets performance and quality requirements.

• Carry out leak tests, bake-out system installation and non-evaporable-getter (NEG) activation on vacuum components and assemblies.

• Assemble and prepare mechanical and vacuum systems for installation and operation.

• Support the installation, testing and commissioning of equipment for the LHC upgrade programme.

• Prepare technical documentation, test reports and intervention records.

• Coordinate with suppliers and support the procurement and delivery of technical components.

• Participate in maintenance, upgrade and repair activities on equipment installed in the LHC tunnel.
 Your profile

• Experience with helium leak detection methods and equipment.

• Experience with on-site vacuum system work, including mechanical installation and in-situ testing.

• Basic experience with outgassing phenomena in vacuum systems and with quadruple mass spectrometers (RGA) for residual gas analysis in UHV environments.

• Practical familiarity with techniques for achieving and maintaining UHV conditions.
 Skills

• Understanding of ultra-high vacuum (UHV) principles and fundamentals.

• The ability to analyse data from ultra-high vacuum (UHV) gauges.

• Basic knowledge on how to assemble and install UHV-compatible components and systems.

• Knowledge of helium leak detector use and the ability to perform leak testing and interpret results.

• The ability to prepare, update, and manage technical documentation.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in BSc in Technical and Applied Studies (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 20.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-November-2026
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.
 Job reference: TE-VSC-BVO-2026-211-GRAE
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark job: 301190 - Mechanical Technical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

jobs.title: Electrical or Electronics Technical Engineer (TE-MPE-MP-2026-214-GRAE)
jobs.description:
If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving and learning through hands-on experimentation, this role could be for you.
 From testing advanced electrical and electronic systems, this role offers a unique opportunity to develop practical engineering skills in a world-leading research environment.
 As a member of the team developing CERN's 13 kA Energy Extraction System controls, you will contribute to system testing, troubleshooting, data acquisition, hardware installation and commissioning systems.
 Your responsibilities:

• Set up instrumentation devices (oscilloscopes, measurement probes, function generators, etc.) and conduct commissioning and performance qualification tests.

• Debug and troubleshoot electronic and electrical circuits.

• PCB tests and validation.

• Set up DAQ devices.

• Data collection and analysis.

• Test report preparation.

• Assemble, test and install electronic chassis.

• Test hardware performance validation.
 Your profile:

• Experience in the installation, test, troubleshooting of electrical and/or electronic circuits and devices.

• Experience with instrumentation (setting up measurement devices such as oscilloscopes, measurement probes, function generators, etc).

• Experience of PCB production and tests.

• Basic experience with set up DAQ systems and electrical/electronic signals data analysis.

• Experience with test stations validating the performance of control electronic and electrical production would be an advantage.
 Skills:

• Knowledge of electrical and/or electronic circuits, debugging and measurement techniques.

• Basic knowledge of Electromechanical devices and maintenance.

• Ability to write test reports and documentation.

• Knowledge of using mechanical tooling during the installation of the equipment would be an asset.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electrical or Electronics Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

jobs.description:
Within the framework of the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider project, and long shutdown activities, you will join the Cryogenic Group as a full member of the team, working in a multidisciplinary environment focused on cryogenic instrumentation, control systems, and electrical engineering. You will contribute to R&D activities, as well as to the design, reception, and maintenance of tooling and test benches used for validation and commissioning operations.
 Your responsibilities

• Contribute to the development of new cryogenic instrumentation like pressure, level, temperature or heater, ensuring their design, qualification, and adaptation to the complex and challenging operating conditions of CERN accelerators, including cryogenic environments, high magnetic fields, and other harsh constraints inherent to accelerator operation.

• Ensure the maintenance of existing test benches based on LabVIEW, including legacy systems, while also developing new test facilities for the qualification of series of radiation-tolerant electronic cards, the calibration of absolute and differential pressure sensors, and associated data analysis.

• Provide field support for cryogenic instrumentation deployed across CERN accelerators, cryogenic plants, and test facilities, including diagnostics, maintenance, and repair activities to ensure reliable and continuous operation of the equipment.
 More information here .
 Your profile

• Testing, calibration, and validation of instrumentation sensors under cryogenic conditions.

• Experience with front-end and back-end electronics, as well as real-time data acquisition systems.

• Performance analysis and optimisation of cryogenic instrumentation systems.
 Skills

• Metrology, Radiology, LabView or similar, Python, data acquisition system.

• Diagnostics and troubleshooting of electrical and instrumentation issues in complex process systems.

• Applying practical knowledge of measurement and electronic technologies in operational environments,

• Collaborating within multidisciplinary teams and contributing to the training and supervision of students.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Applied Physics/Electromechanical Engineering, Electronic Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

 You will be part of the Experimental Physics (EP) Department, which carries out basic research. This Department aims at providing a stimulating scientific atmosphere and remains an important reference centre for the European physics community.
 Functions:

• Contribute to particle physics experiment projects at CERN.

• Participate in the design and development of experiments and detectors.

• Support the operation and performance of detector systems.

• Analyse experimental data and contribute to physics results.

• Collaborate with international teams and document results.

• PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Physics or a related field.
 Experience:

• You are towards the beginning of your career, but have already demonstrated some years of post-doctoral experience in experimental particle physics.

• Experience in data analysis and online/offline software.

• Demonstrated competence in detector hardware and experimental instrumentation.

• Knowledge and application of electromagnetic radiation propagation and interaction with matter.

• Physics analysis and experimental particle physics.

• Particle detectors and interaction of particles with matter.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: keeping up-to-date with developments in own field of expertise and readily absorbing new information.

• Building Relationships: relating well to all people regardless of category/level within the Organisation.

• Working in the Interest of the Organisation: actively promoting safety and encouraging others to do the same; respecting safety rules and procedures.
 Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

• Your CV (English or French).

• A copy of your PhD Degree.

• A list of up to ten most-important publications indicating where you have been a principal contributor or co-author, indicating your contribution to each publication in a couple of lines.

• A one-page cover letter, giving your motivation in applying for this position.

jobs.title: Agile Coach (FAP-BC-DL-2026-142-GRAP)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities As an Agile Coach, you will join the Delivery section within the Business Computing group. Your mission will be to coach, mentor, and train teams and business partners on lean-agile practices in software development, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. We are looking for someone highly motivated and passionate about business agility.
 The group is currently in the preparation phase for two business transformation projects: one covering Finance, Procurement, and Logistics processes (new ERP system) and, in parallel, the implementation of a new Human Capital Management system. This requires strong coordination and cross-functional collaboration across the group. As an Agile Coach, you will be assigned to one of the projects to contribute to the successful implementation.
 Being part of the Lean/Agile chapter, you will drive BC Group events, help grow the Agile maturity of all group internal actors (teams, designers, product managers, the group management team itself) and work with the external group stakeholders to increase their awareness, acceptance and embrace of the group's Agile ways of working. You will be aiming to deepen business agility fundamentals and lean portfolio management concepts within the group, leading to a healthier relationship between the group and its business partners.
 Your responsibilities
 In this position, your main functions will be:

• Cooperate in coordinating the business transformation projects.

• Train individuals and teams in agile techniques and frameworks.

• Design a strategy for improving the collaboration and flow of information between software development teams and their business stakeholders.

• Coach and facilitate agile workshops for product teams, business representatives, and other stakeholders on Lean/Agile practices and tools.

• Work with the Lean/Agile Chapter to increase the knowledge of Lean/Agile Practices, ensuring the organisation is at the forefront of industry best practices.

• Promote an agile mindset and foster an environment for high-performing team dynamics, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• This role includes team supervision responsibilities.

Your profile

• Experience working with Scrum teams in a scaled Agile context.

• Experience with Product Management frameworks.

• Experience with business transformation projects (e.g., ERP or HCM implementations).
 Skills
 Soft skills:

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and organisational skills.
 Technical skills:

• Knowledge of scaled Agile frameworks and how to put them into practice.

• Knowledge of business transformation projects (e.g., ERP or HCM implementations).

• Agile certifications (e.g., Scrum Master, Leading SAFe).

• Design thinking skills.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Computer Science, Organisational Psychology (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 21.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Please note that interviews will take place in the last week of September.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Job flexibility: Hybrid
 Target start date: 01-January-2027
 Job reference: FAP-BC-DL-2026-142-GRAP
 Field of work: Information Technologies
 Benchmark job: 5A0010 - Business Process Analyst

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

Your responsibilities As an Agile Coach, you will join the Delivery section within the Business Computing group. Your mission will be to coach, mentor, and train teams and business partners on lean-agile practices in software development, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. We are looking for someone highly motivated and passionate about business agility.
The group is currently in the preparation phase for two business transformation projects: one covering Finance, Procurement, and Logistics processes (new ERP system) and, in parallel, the implementation of a new Human Capital Management system. This requires strong coordination and cross-functional collaboration across the group. As an Agile Coach, you will be assigned to one of the projects to contribute to the successful implementation.
Being part of the Lean/Agile chapter, you will drive BC Group events, help grow the Agile maturity of all group internal actors (teams, designers, product managers, the group management team itself) and work with the external group stakeholders to increase their awareness, acceptance and embrace of the group's Agile ways of working. You will be aiming to deepen business agility fundamentals and lean portfolio management concepts within the group, leading to a healthier relationship between the group and its business partners.
Your responsibilities
In this position, your main functions will be:

• Cooperate in coordinating the business transformation projects.

• Train individuals and teams in agile techniques and frameworks.

• Design a strategy for improving the collaboration and flow of information between software development teams and their business stakeholders.

• Coach and facilitate agile workshops for product teams, business representatives, and other stakeholders on Lean/Agile practices and tools.

• Work with the Lean/Agile Chapter to increase the knowledge of Lean/Agile Practices, ensuring the organisation is at the forefront of industry best practices.

• Promote an agile mindset and foster an environment for high-performing team dynamics, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• This role includes team supervision responsibilities.

Your profile

• Experience working with Scrum teams in a scaled Agile context.

• Experience with Product Management frameworks.

• Experience with business transformation projects (e.g., ERP or HCM implementations).
Skills
Soft skills:

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and organisational skills.
Technical skills:

• Knowledge of scaled Agile frameworks and how to put them into practice.

• Knowledge of business transformation projects (e.g., ERP or HCM implementations).

• Agile certifications (e.g., Scrum Master, Leading SAFe).

• Design thinking skills.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Computer Science, Organisational Psychology (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 21.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Please note that interviews will take place in the last week of September.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Job flexibility: Hybrid

Job reference: FAP-BC-DL-2026-142-GRAP

• A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to contribute to the Future Circular Collider (FCC), one of the most ambitious scientific projects ever envisioned? Help develop the coating technology that will equip its vacuum chambers with a Non-Evaporable Getter thin film.
 Working alongside experienced engineers, technicians and physicists, you will contribute to the design, fabrication and coating.
 You will be involved at every stage of the process. We will provide all the necessary training and support, making this an excellent opportunity to develop specialist skills in a unique international environment.
 Your responsibilities:

• Design & construction of mechanical parts for customised physical vapor deposition systems and associated tooling.

• Assembly of coating setups operating in Ultra High Vacuum.

• Validation of the coating technology and process (in real scale prototypes up to 12 meter long beam pipes).

• Validation of the vacuum performance of the coatings produced (in Ultra High Vacuum systems).
 Your profile:

• Experience in machining metal parts in lathe and milling machines. CNC would be an advantage.

• Familiarity in using CAD software to design mechanical parts.

• Practical experience in assembling mechanical equipment.

• Experience in vacuum technology would be an advantage.
 Skills:

• Working in teams.

• Curious and proactive.

• Knowledge of vacuum technology would be an advantage.

• Knowledge on welding would be an advantage.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 20.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-November-2026
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job reference: TE-VSC-SCC-2026-212-GRAE
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark job: 300090 - Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
